layers.name: core
layers.description: Foundation subsystems: config, environment, lifecycle, registry, exceptions

layers.name: data
layers.description: Database contract, ORM, query builder, repository, migrations, cache

layers.name: web
layers.description: Web/REST runtime: adapter, routing, request/response, resource, validation, realtime

layers.name: auth
layers.description: Authentication and authorization (identity resolution, access control)

layers.name: ratelimit
layers.description: Fixed-window rate limiting for the request pipeline

layers.name: cache
layers.description: Backend-agnostic cache with TTL and web middleware

layers.name: jobs
layers.description: Background job system: queue, job runner, scheduler

layers.name: infrastructure
layers.description: Infrastructure services: queue, scheduler, retry, email, health

layers.name: generators
layers.description: Code generators: project, module, resource, service, CRUD, migration, extension

layers.name: architecture
layers.description: Architecture Guard: canonical architecture rule enforcement

dependency_rules: core MUST NOT depend on cli, runtime, diagnostics, or ai
runtime MUST NOT depend on cli or diagnostics
diagnostics MUST NOT depend on cli
cli MUST depend only on core, runtime, and diagnostics
ai MUST depend only on core, runtime, and diagnostics
data MUST depend only on core and runtime
web MUST depend only on core, runtime, and diagnostics
auth MUST depend only on core and web
ratelimit MUST depend only on core and web
cache MUST depend only on core, data, and web
jobs MUST depend only on core and runtime
infrastructure MUST depend only on core and runtime
generators MUST depend only on core and runtime
architecture MUST depend only on core and runtime
extension_points: lifecycle handlers (on_bootstrap, on_initialize, on_ready, on_start, on_stop, on_shutdown, on_error)
